opennyai_summary.decision:
The instant contempt petition has been filed by the petitioner for non- compliance of order dated 02.03.2024 passed by this Court wherein, respondent No. 2-District Collector Land Acquisition (Deputy Commissioner), Samba was directed to consider the representation dated 12.01.2024 submitted by the petitioner before him and take a decision thereon expeditiously in light of the provisions contained in Section 3H(4) of the National Highways Act, 1956.
It was further directed that till such time, respondent No. 2 takes a decision on the representation sated to have been filed by the petitioner, no further amount of compensation in respect of the land which is the subject matter of the instant petition shall be released.
02.
Compliance report stands filed wherein it is stated that the respondent in compliance to the judgment/order dated 02.03.2024 passed by this Court has considered the representation dated 12.01.2024 vide order No. DCS/LAS/2024- 25/38 dated 19.11.2024 wherein it was observed that he is claiming payment of land compensation in respect of the acquired land on which he has no right,
and therefore, his claim is unjustified and resultantly his representation is found devoid of merits and hence rejected.
In view of the compliance report filed by the respondent, order (supra) passed by this Court stands complied with, therefore, the proceedings in the instant contempt petition, are accordingly,
closed.
04. However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to challenge the consideration order, if so advised.
05. In view of the above, the instant contempt petition is 'disposed of.'
